findings.summary: SaveUploadedFile unconditionally chmods the parent directory of dst (even "." or a shared existing directory) on every call, which can alter existing directory modes, lock out users, or fail with EPERM; it should be dropped or limited to directories MkdirAll created.

The variadic `perm` parameter only sets the directory mode, not the saved file's mode, which is misleading; the doc comment doesn't say so, and extra variadic values after perm[0] are silently ignored.

TestSaveUploadedFileWithPermission asserts on the current directory (filepath.Dir("permission_test") is ".") instead of a created directory, passes only because of the buggy chmod, leaves the directory at 0o755, leaves a stray file in the repo, and may vary with umask; it should use t.TempDir() with a nested path.

TestSaveUploadedFileWithPermissionFailed depends on the environment: it expects an error from a non-executable directory, which doesn't occur when running as root (e.g. CI containers), and it leaves a test/ directory behind.
